name: @dsh-toolset/coagent
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）进程内集成插件：经 herdr-use 服务面在交互终端里拉起长驻 dsh 会话（独立进程、上下文零继承），认领后把 terminal_id / session_id 交给调用方；只管拉起与收尾

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-coagent && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-coagent && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-coagent node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-coagent tmp/cov-coagent/report.json
